answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 14765 Country: India Title: If I want to pray in mosque , salah time has started but there is time for a adhan (Normally in asian country there is gap between starting time of salah and adhan) and I have to pray early due to some engagment (may be i have to catch some transort or some appointment) is it necessary to give adahn? If I give adhan for me then there will be second adhan for normal prayer is it correct or i should pray my salah without adhan? Question: If I want to pray in mosque , salah time has started but there is time for a adhan (Normally in asian country there is gap between starting time of salah and adhan) and I have to pray early due to some engagment (may be i have to catch some transort or some appointment) is it necessary to give adahn? If I give adhan for me then there will be second adhan for normal prayer is it correct or i should pray my salah without adhan? Answer ID: 14765 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1259/1197=B/1430) Sometime in urgent cases, you can go after performing salah with azan and iqamah. Your azan and iqamah will not suffice for the locality; they will call separate azan and iqamah for their salah. If you performed salah without azan and iqamah, then also your salah will be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
